summary: Prebuilt binary opens WebSocket-driven PTY shell and modifies shell RC on install
details: The package ships a Mach-O Go binary at bin/ccfly-setup that links github.com/creack/pty and github.com/gorilla/websocket, and embeds hardcoded WebSocket destinations (ws://ccfly, wss://Acceptlatest.zshrc.ccfly). The combination of PTY spawning and a remote WebSocket connection to a hardcoded endpoint gives a remote party interactive shell control over the installer's host. The binary also contains strings referencing ~/.zshrc modification (latest.zshrc), an http://approveccfly-*/redeem endpoint, claude.ai:443, and a query against https://registry.npmjs.org, indicating a persistence mechanism via shell-init modification plus an account-brokering component alongside the remote-shell channel.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
